summary: A React + Mapbox web app that maps family/kid-friendly spots along Florida's 30A. Being re-architected from a single-file prototype into a componentized app with a Tailwind design-token styling layer and a Supabase backend, including a moderated 'Add a Spot' submission flow.
stage_label: Phase 5 of 6: Hover popover on map pins
next_step: Implement Phase 5: add hover popover to map pins in MapView.jsx (hoveredSpotId state + react-map-gl <Popup> showing name/address/description, desktop-only, click still opens SpotCard).
notes: Phases 1-4 complete: monolith split into components/data/hooks/lib; inline styles migrated to Tailwind design tokens (remaining inline styles are legitimately dynamic - category colors/sizes/heights - and no hardcoded hex left in components); Supabase read path (fetchSpots + useSpots + seed script) and write path (submitSpot with Mapbox geocoding, random-coordinates bug fixed) both wired; Supabase project provisioned and seeded (backend live). Phase 5 (hover popover) not started - no hover code in MapView.jsx. Phase 6 (email notification via Resend + Supabase Edge Function) not started - no supabase/functions dir. Specs live in mom-map-rearchitecture-spec.md (master 6-phase plan), mom-map-hover-popover-spec.md (Phase 5), mom-map-email-notification-spec.md (Phase 6). Phase 6 is server-side only and depends on Phase 3.
